# To reproduce the analysis, users must place restricted SNIS and sensor data files in the data / subdirectories specified below and spatial data must be downloaded per the instructions in the Readme. The code will not run if the data are not present.


#Libraries
```{r libs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(here) #For generalized file paths

project_dir <- here()

data_dir    <- here("data")
sensor_dir  <- here("data", "sensor")
snis_dir    <- here("data", "snis")
survey_dir  <- here("data", "survey")
spatial_dir <- here("data", "spatial")

output_dir  <- here("output")
temp_dir    <- here("output", "temp")



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

library(fixest)
library(lfe)
library(broom)
library(lmtest)
library(clubSandwich)
library(modelsummary)

library(SuperLearner)
library(ltmle)
library(cobalt)
```

## READ IN DATA
```{r readdata, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------ Read in SNIS data------------------
analyticaldataset <- file.path(
  snis_dir,
  "snis_analytical_FINAL.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(analyticaldataset)) {
  message("SNIS analytical dataset not found. See README for access instructions.")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

snis_analytical <- readRDS(analyticaldataset)

# ------------------ Read in spatial data-----------------
spatial_covariates_path <- file.path(
  spatial_dir,
  "health_zone_spatial_covariates.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(spatial_covariates_path)) {
  message("Spatial covariates file not found. See README for access instructions.")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

spatial_covariates <- read.csv(spatial_covariates_path)

snis_filtered <- snis_analytical %>%
  filter(!is.na(A5_province), !is.na(A6_zone))

snis_filtered <- snis_filtered %>%
  mutate(A6_zone = recode_factor(A6_zone,
    "Ruashi"       = "Rwashi",
    "Haut Plateau" = "Hauts-Plateaux",
    "Miti Murhesa" = "Miti-Murhesa",
    "Kimbe Lulenge"= "Kimbi Lulenge"
  ))

# ------------------ Merge with spatial covariates ------------------
# Match Nom <-> A6_zone and PROVINCE <-> A5_province
snis_merged <- snis_filtered %>%
  left_join(spatial_covariates, 
            by = c("A6_zone" = "Nom"))

# ------------------ Check for missing spatial data ------------------
# Count how many rows did NOT get matched
missing_count <- sum(is.na(snis_merged$wealth_mean))
total_rows <- nrow(snis_merged)

cat("Number of unmatched rows (missing spatial covariates):", missing_count, "\n")
cat("Total rows after merge:", total_rows, "\n")
cat("Percent unmatched:", round(100 * missing_count / total_rows, 2), "%\n")

#Replace missing spatial values
snis_merged <- snis_merged %>%
  group_by(A5_province) %>%
  mutate(wealth_mean = ifelse(is.na(wealth_mean), median(wealth_mean, na.rm = TRUE), wealth_mean)) %>%
  mutate(pop_density_mean = ifelse(is.na(pop_density_mean), median(pop_density_mean, na.rm = TRUE), pop_density_mean)) %>%
  mutate(dist_paved_km_mean = ifelse(is.na(dist_paved_km), median(dist_paved_km, na.rm = TRUE), dist_paved_km)) %>%
  ungroup()

snis_merged <- snis_merged %>%
  mutate(
    pop_density_raw = pop_density_mean,
    pop_density_mean = log1p(pop_density_mean),
    dist_paved_km_mean = log1p(dist_paved_km_mean)
  )

```

## TMLE PREP - Shifting treatment to start based on survey install date
```{r shiftedtreatment, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ------------------------
# Step 1: Prepare  dataset
# ------------------------
snis_filtered <- snis_merged %>%
  filter(facilitytype != "PH") %>%         # drop PH
  filter(facilitytype != "H") %>%          # drop H
  filter(tmle_shifted==1) %>%
  mutate(
    month_date_full = my(month),           # convert YYYY-MM to date
    month_only = month(month_date_full, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, month_date) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%                     # keep unique facility-month
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------
# Step 2: Define treatment start date per facility
# ---------------------------
snis_filtered <- snis_filtered %>%
  mutate(suff_reliable = as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.917))

snis_filtered <- snis_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    treat_date = case_when(
      suff_reliable == 1 & grid == 1 & !is.na(B2_grid_date) ~ B2_grid_date,
      suff_reliable == 1 & grid == 0 & solar == 1 & !is.na(D2_solar_date) ~ D2_solar_date,
      suff_reliable == 1 & grid == 0 & solar == 0 & generator == 1 & !is.na(C3_1_gen_date) ~ C3_1_gen_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Step 3: Create dynamic suff_reliable
# ---------------------------
ltmle_data <- snis_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    suff_reliable = case_when(
      !is.na(treat_date) & month_date_full >= treat_date ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, month_date) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(time = dense_rank(month_date)) %>%   # sequential time index per facility
  ungroup() %>%
  select(id, suff_reliable, time, mortrate_active,
         uptime, uptime2, uptime3, facilitytype, month_only,
         province, outpatientcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean,
         dist_paved_km_mean, theft, treat_date, bedcount, mean_events, mean_fatalities)


# ---------------------------
# Step 4: Remove all-zero mortality facilities
# ---------------------------
zero_mort_ids <- ltmle_data %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_active == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(all_zero) %>%
  pull(id)

ltmle_data <- ltmle_data %>%
  filter(!id %in% zero_mort_ids)

# ---------------------------
# Step 5: Reshape to wide format
# ---------------------------
# Outcomes
Y_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, mortrate_active, suff_reliable) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mortrate_active,
              names_prefix = "Y_")

# Month covariate
month_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, month_only) %>%
  mutate(month_only = factor(month_only, levels = month.name)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = month_only,
              names_prefix = "L_month_")

# Outpatient covariate
outpatient_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, outpatientcount) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = outpatientcount,
              names_prefix = "L_outpatient_")

# Baseline controls
controls <- ltmle_data %>%
  filter(time == 1) %>%
  select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount,
         wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities)

# ---------------------------
# Step 6: Merge everything
# ---------------------------
ltmle_wide <- Y_wide %>%
  left_join(month_wide, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(outpatient_wide, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(controls, by = "id")

# ---------------------------
# Step 7: Define node sets
# ---------------------------
Ynodes <- grep("^Y_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
L_month_nodes <- grep("^L_month_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
L_outpatient_nodes <- grep("^L_outpatient_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Step 8: Prep ltmle-ready dataset
# ---------------------------
ltmle_ready <- ltmle_wide %>%
  mutate(
    suff_reliable = as.numeric(suff_reliable),
    across(all_of(Ynodes), as.numeric),
    across(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ factor(., levels = month.name)),
    facilitytype = as.factor(facilitytype),
    province = as.factor(province),
    theft = as.factor(theft),
    wealth_mean = as.numeric(wealth_mean),
    pop_density_mean = as.numeric(pop_density_mean),
    dist_paved_km_mean = as.numeric(dist_paved_km_mean),
    mean_events = as.numeric(mean_events),
    mean_fatalities = as.numeric(mean_fatalities)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(suff_reliable)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bedcount)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(facilitytype), !is.na(province)) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(Ynodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount,
         wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities,
         suff_reliable, all_of(L_month_nodes), all_of(L_outpatient_nodes),
         all_of(Ynodes))

ltmle_ready <- ltmle_ready %>%
  select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities, suff_reliable,  all_of(L_month_nodes), all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), all_of(Ynodes))

# ---------------------------
# Step 9: Run TMLE
# ---------------------------
gform <- c(suff_reliable = "suff_reliable ~ id + province + facilitytype + theft + bedcount + wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities")

set.seed(8675309)

SL.xgboost.custom <- function(..., seed = 8675309) {
  set.seed(seed); SL.xgboost(...)
}
SL.randomForest.custom <- function(..., seed = 8675309) {
  set.seed(seed); SL.randomForest(...)
}

mortrate_shifted_2 <- ltmle(
  data = ltmle_ready,
  Anodes = "suff_reliable",
  Lnodes = c(L_month_nodes, L_outpatient_nodes),
  Ynodes = Ynodes,
  abar = list(treated = 1, untreated = 0),
  SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.mean", "SL.gam", "SL.rpart",
                 "SL.xgboost.custom", "SL.randomForest.custom"),
  gform = gform
)

# ---------------------------
# Step 10: Summarize results
# ---------------------------
summary(mortrate_shifted_2)


post_2021_facilities <- snis_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(treat_date)) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(first_treat = min(treat_date, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(after_jan2021 = first_treat > ymd("2021-01-31"))
sum(post_2021_facilities$after_jan2021)

```

## TMLE RUNS (Main specification) - Main Results Table 2
```{r mortrate_suff_reli_917, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}

###### Mortality rate, suff + reliable (91.7% uptime3) ######

snis_filtered <- snis_merged %>%
  filter(facilitytype != "PH") %>%

  ) %>%

  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()


# Step 2: Create suff_reliable and time index
ltmle_data <- snis_filtered %>%
  mutate(suff_reliable = as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.917)) %>%
  arrange(id, month_date) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(time = dense_rank(month_date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(id, suff_reliable, time, mortrate_active, uptime, uptime2, uptime3, facilitytype, month_only, province, outpatientcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, theft, inpatientcount_active, surgicaldeaths, mortrate_surgical, obgyndeaths, mortrate_obgyn, pedsdeaths, mortrate_peds, internalmeddeaths, mortrate_internalmed, nurse_A2_attendrate, doctor_attendrate, surgical_count, obgyn_count, peds_count, internalmed_count, nurse_A1, nurse_A2, doctor, labtech, bedcount, mean_events, mean_fatalities)

snis_filtered %>%
  filter(is.na(uptime)) %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  nrow()


# Step 3: Remove facilities with all-zero mortality
zero_mort_ids <- ltmle_data %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_active == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(all_zero) %>%
  pull(id)

ltmle_data <- ltmle_data %>%
  filter(!id %in% zero_mort_ids)

# Step 4a: Reshape outcomes to wide format
Y_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, mortrate_active, suff_reliable) %>%  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = time,
    values_from = mortrate_active,
    names_prefix = "Y_"
  )

# Step 4b: Reshape month_only to wide format (MATCHING timepoints)
month_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, month_only) %>%
  mutate(month_only = factor(month_only, levels = month.name)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = time,
    values_from = month_only,
    names_prefix = "L_month_"
  )

outpatient_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
  select(id, time, outpatientcount) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = time,
    values_from = outpatientcount,
    names_prefix = "L_outpatient_"
  )

controls <- ltmle_data %>%
  filter(time == 1) %>%
  select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities)

# Step 5: Combine wide-format datasets
ltmle_wide <- Y_wide %>%
  left_join(month_wide, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(outpatient_wide, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(controls, by = "id")

# Step 6: Define node names
Ynodes <- grep("^Y_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
L_month_nodes <- grep("^L_month_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
L_outpatient_nodes <- grep("^L_outpatient_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)

# Step 7: Prepare ltmle_ready dataset
ltmle_ready <- ltmle_wide %>%
  mutate(
    suff_reliable = as.numeric(suff_reliable),
    across(all_of(Ynodes), as.numeric),
    across(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ factor(., levels = month.name)),
    facilitytype = as.factor(facilitytype),
    province = as.factor(province),
    theft = as.factor(theft),
    wealth_mean = as.numeric(wealth_mean),
    pop_density_mean = as.numeric(pop_density_mean),
    dist_paved_km_mean = as.numeric(dist_paved_km_mean),
    mean_events = as.numeric(mean_events),
    mean_fatalities = as.numeric(mean_fatalities)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(suff_reliable)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bedcount)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(facilitytype)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(province)) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(Ynodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ !is.na(.)))    

# Step 8: Reorder so Lnodes come before Ynodes
ltmle_ready <- ltmle_ready %>%
  select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities, suff_reliable,  all_of(L_month_nodes), all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), all_of(Ynodes))

gform <- c(suff_reliable = "suff_reliable ~ id + province + facilitytype + theft + bedcount + wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities")

  abar = list(treated = 1, untreated = 0),
```

## DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS - Main Results Table 1
```{r dstats, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
ltmleready_ids <- ltmle_ready %>%
    select(id)

ids_to_keep_summary <- ltmleready_ids$id

ltmle_summarystats <- ltmle_data %>%
  filter(id %in% ids_to_keep_summary) 

ltmle_summary_prov <- ltmle_summarystats %>%
  group_by(province) %>%   
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    n_ids = n_distinct(id)
  )

ltmle_summary <- ltmle_summarystats %>%
  group_by(facilitytype, suff_reliable) %>%   
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),   
    across(
      c(mortrate_active, uptime, uptime2, uptime3, theft, bedcount,
        wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, outpatientcount, inpatientcount_active, surgical_count, surgicaldeaths, mortrate_surgical, obgyn_count, obgyndeaths, mortrate_obgyn, peds_count, pedsdeaths, mortrate_peds, internalmed_count, internalmeddeaths, mortrate_internalmed, nurse_A2_attendrate, doctor_attendrate, nurse_A1, nurse_A2, doctor, labtech, mean_events, mean_fatalities),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE),  # coerce numeric to avoid NA issues
        sd   = ~ sd(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall summary (drop suff_reliable distinction here, just aggregate full sample)
overall_summary <- ltmle_summarystats %>%
  summarise(
    facilitytype = "Overall",
    suff_reliable = NA_integer_,   # same type as your data
    n_obs = n(),
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),  
    across(
      c(mortrate_active, uptime, uptime2, uptime3, theft, bedcount,
        wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, outpatientcount, inpatientcount_active, surgical_count, surgicaldeaths, mortrate_surgical, obgyn_count, obgyndeaths, mortrate_obgyn, peds_count, pedsdeaths, mortrate_peds, internalmed_count, internalmeddeaths, mortrate_internalmed, nurse_A2_attendrate, doctor_attendrate, nurse_A1, nurse_A2, doctor, labtech, mean_events, mean_fatalities),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~ sd(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Combine by-facilitytype/suff_reliable and overall into one table
final_summary <- bind_rows(ltmle_summary, overall_summary)

write.csv(final_summary, "final_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r pathwaystesting, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
  )
```

## TMLE RUNS (All specifications) - Main Results Table 2
```{r altspecifications, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ---------------------------
# Treatment definitions
# ---------------------------
treatment_defs <- list(
  suff_uptime_917 = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.917)),
  suff_uptime2_917  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.917)),
  suff_uptime3_917 = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.917)),
  uptime_only_917 = quote(as.integer(uptime > 0.917)),
  uptime3_only_917 = quote(as.integer(uptime3 > 0.917)),
  suff_only        = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1)),  
  suff_uptime3_85  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.85)),
  suff_uptime3_86  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.86)),
  suff_uptime3_87  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.87)),
  suff_uptime3_88  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.88)),
  suff_uptime3_89  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.89)),
  suff_uptime3_90  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.90)),
  suff_uptime3_91  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.91)),
  suff_uptime3_92  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.92)),
  suff_uptime3_93  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.93)),
  suff_uptime3_94  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.94)),
  suff_uptime3_95  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime3 > 0.95)),
    suff_uptime_85  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.85)),
  suff_uptime_86  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.86)),
  suff_uptime_87  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.87)),
  suff_uptime_88  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.88)),
  suff_uptime_89  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.89)),
  suff_uptime_90  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.90)),
  suff_uptime_91  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.91)),
  suff_uptime_92  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.92)),
  suff_uptime_93  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.93)),
  suff_uptime_94  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.94)),
  suff_uptime_95  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.95)),
    suff_uptime2_85  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.85)),
  suff_uptime2_86  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.86)),
  suff_uptime2_87  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.87)),
  suff_uptime2_88  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.88)),
  suff_uptime2_89  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.89)),
  suff_uptime2_90  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.90)),
  suff_uptime2_91  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.91)),
  suff_uptime2_92  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.92)),
  suff_uptime2_93  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.93)),
  suff_uptime2_94  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.94)),
  suff_uptime2_95  = quote(as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime2 > 0.95))
)

# ---------------------------
# Initialize storage
# ---------------------------
tmle_results_list <- list()
tmle_fits <- list()

# ---------------------------
# Loop through treatment definitions
# ---------------------------
for (nm in names(treatment_defs)) {
  message("Running model: ", nm)

  # Prep
  snis_filtered <- snis_merged %>%
    filter(!facilitytype %in% c("PH", "H")) %>%
    filter(tmle_list==1) %>%
    mutate(
      month_date_full = my(month),
      month_only = month(month_date_full, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(id, month_date) %>%
    filter(n() == 1) %>%
    ungroup()

  ltmle_data <- snis_filtered %>%
    mutate(suff_reliable = eval(treatment_defs[[nm]])) %>%
    arrange(id, month_date) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(time = dense_rank(month_date)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(id, suff_reliable, time, mortrate_active,
           sufficient, uptime, uptime2, uptime3,
           facilitytype, month_only, province, theft, bedcount, outpatientcount,
           wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities, ols_list)

  zero_mort_ids <- ltmle_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_active == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(all_zero) %>%
    pull(id)

  ltmle_data <- ltmle_data %>% filter(!id %in% zero_mort_ids)

  # Wide reshape
  Y_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, mortrate_active, suff_reliable) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mortrate_active, names_prefix = "Y_")

  month_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, month_only) %>%
    mutate(month_only = factor(month_only, levels = month.name)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = month_only, names_prefix = "L_month_")

  outpatient_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, outpatientcount) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = outpatientcount, names_prefix = "L_outpatient_")

  controls <- ltmle_data %>%
    filter(time == 1) %>%
    select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities)

  ltmle_wide <- Y_wide %>%
    left_join(month_wide, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(outpatient_wide, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(controls, by = "id")

  # Nodes
  Ynodes <- grep("^Y_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
  L_month_nodes <- grep("^L_month_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
  L_outpatient_nodes <- grep("^L_outpatient_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)

  # Final prep
  ltmle_ready <- ltmle_wide %>%
    mutate(
      suff_reliable = as.numeric(suff_reliable),
      across(all_of(Ynodes), as.numeric),
      across(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ factor(., levels = month.name)),
      facilitytype = as.factor(facilitytype),
      province = as.factor(province),
      theft = as.factor(theft),
      wealth_mean = as.numeric(wealth_mean),
      pop_density_mean = as.numeric(pop_density_mean),
      dist_paved_km_mean = as.numeric(dist_paved_km_mean),
      mean_events = as.numeric(mean_events),
      mean_fatalities = as.numeric(mean_fatalities)
   ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(suff_reliable)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bedcount)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(facilitytype), !is.na(province)) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(Ynodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    filter(if_any(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, mean_events, mean_fatalities,
           suff_reliable, all_of(L_month_nodes), all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), all_of(Ynodes))
  
  # Run TMLE
  gform <- c(suff_reliable = "suff_reliable ~ id + province + facilitytype + theft + bedcount+ wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities")
  set.seed(8675309)
  tmle_result <- ltmle(
    data = ltmle_ready,
    Anodes = "suff_reliable",
    Lnodes = c(L_month_nodes, L_outpatient_nodes),
    Ynodes = Ynodes,
    abar = list(treated = 1, untreated = 0),
    SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.mean", "SL.gam", "SL.rpart",
                   "SL.xgboost.custom", "SL.randomForest.custom"),
    gform = gform
  )

  tmle_sum <- summary(tmle_result)

  # Save both fit & summary
  tmle_fits[[nm]] <- tmle_result
  tmle_results_list[[nm]] <- data.frame(
    treatment = nm,
    ate = tmle_sum$effect.measures$ATE$estimate,
    se = tmle_sum$effect.measures$ATE$std.dev,
    ci_low = tmle_sum$effect.measures$ATE$CI[1],
    ci_high = tmle_sum$effect.measures$ATE$CI[2],
    pval = tmle_sum$effect.measures$ATE$pvalue,
    control_mean = tmle_sum$effect.measures$control$estimate,
    treated_mean = tmle_sum$effect.measures$treatment$estimate,
    treated = sum(ltmle_ready$suff_reliable == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    control = sum(ltmle_ready$suff_reliable == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Combine results
tmle_results_df <- bind_rows(tmle_results_list, .id = "model_name")
```

## OLS AND IPW ESTIMATES (Models and balance tests) - Supplementary Materials Table S2, Figure S1, Figure S2
```{r OLS_IPW, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
## --- Data prep (panel) ---
robust_data <- ltmle_data %>%
  mutate(
    A = as.integer(suff_reliable),
    Y = mortrate_active,
    province = as.factor(province),
    facilitytype = as.factor(facilitytype),
    month_only = factor(month_only, levels = month.name)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(A), !is.na(Y)) %>%
  filter(ols_list==1) 

baseline_covars <- c("province", "facilitytype",
                     "wealth_mean", "pop_density_mean", "dist_paved_km_mean", "theft", "bedcount", "mean_events", "mean_fatalities")
timevarying_covars <- c("month_only", "outpatientcount")
all_covars <- c(baseline_covars, timevarying_covars)

## =================================
## Naive difference
## =================================
naive <- robust_data %>%
  summarise(
    mean_T = mean(Y[A == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_C = mean(Y[A == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff   = mean_T - mean_C,
    perc   = 100 * (mean_T - mean_C) / mean_C
  )



## =================================
## OLS & IPTW 
## =================================
set.seed(8675309)
SL.lib <- c("SL.glm", "SL.mean", "SL.gam")

ps_fit <- SuperLearner(
  Y = robust_data$A,
  X = robust_data[, all_covars],
  family = binomial(),
  SL.library = SL.lib,
  method = "method.NNLS",
  cvControl = list(V = 5)
)

robust_data$ps <- pmin(pmax(ps_fit$SL.predict, 0.1), 0.9)
robust_data$w <- ifelse(robust_data$A == 1,
                        1, robust_data$ps / (1 - robust_data$ps))

iptw <- feols(Y ~ A ,
              data = robust_data, weights = ~w)

summary(robust_data$w)

# Define sets of controls (additive)
covs_list <- list(
  "None" = "",
  "Facility Type" = "facilitytype + bedcount",
  "+ Area Vars" = "province + facilitytype + bedcount + theft",
  "+ Spatial Vars" = "province + facilitytype + bedcount + theft +
                          wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities",
  "Variable"  = "month_only + outpatientcount",
  "FULL"  = "province + facilitytype + bedcount + theft +
                          wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities +
                          month_only + outpatientcount"
)


robust_trimmed <- robust_data %>%
  filter(ps > 0.05 & ps < 0.95)

ols_models <- lapply(covs_list, function(covs) {
  feols(as.formula(paste("Y ~ A", if (covs != "") paste("+", covs) else "")),
        data = robust_trimmed)
})

ipw_models <- lapply(covs_list, function(covs) {
  feols(as.formula(paste("Y ~ A", if (covs != "") paste("+", covs) else "")),
        data = robust_trimmed, weights = ~w)
})

etable(
  c(ipw_models),
  digits = 3,
  dict = c(
    "A"                = "Suff + Reliable Power",
    "provinceNk"               = "Province: North Kivu",
    "provinceSouthKivu"               = "Province: South Kivu",
    "facilitytypeCM"     = "Facility Type: CM",
    "facilitytypeCSR"     = "Facility Type: CSR",
    "facilitytypeHGR"     = "Facility Type: HGR",
    "bedcount"         = "Bed count",
    "theft"            = "Electricity Theft (0/1)",
    "wealth_mean"      = "Wealth Index",
    "pop_density_mean" = "Population Density",
    "dist_paved_km_mean" = "Distance to paved road (km)",
    "month_only.L"       = "Jan",
    "month_only.Q"       = "Feb",
    "month_only.C"       = "Mar",
    "month_only^4"       = "Apr",
    "month_only^5"       = "May",
    "month_only^6"       = "Jun",
    "month_only^7"       = "Jul",
    "month_only^8"       = "Aug",
    "month_only^9"       = "Sept",
    "month_only^10"       = "Oct",
    "month_only^11"       = "Nov",
    "outpatientcount"  = "Montly Outpatient Count"
  ),
  fitstat = ~ n + ar2, 
  style.tex = style.tex("aer")
)


etable(
  c(ols_models),
  digits = 3,
  dict = c(
    "A"                = "Suff + Reliable Power",
    "provinceNk"               = "Province: North Kivu",
    "provinceSouthKivu"               = "Province: South Kivu",
    "facilitytypeCM"     = "Facility Type: CM",
    "facilitytypeCSR"     = "Facility Type: CSR",
    "facilitytypeHGR"     = "Facility Type: HGR",
    "bedcount"         = "Bed count",
    "theft"            = "Electricity Theft (0/1)",
    "wealth_mean"      = "Wealth Index",
    "pop_density_mean" = "Population Density",
    "dist_paved_km_mean" = "Distance to paved road (km)",
    "month_only.L"       = "Jan",
    "month_only.Q"       = "Feb",
    "month_only.C"       = "Mar",
    "month_only^4"       = "Apr",
    "month_only^5"       = "May",
    "month_only^6"       = "Jun",
    "month_only^7"       = "Jul",
    "month_only^8"       = "Aug",
    "month_only^9"       = "Sept",
    "month_only^10"       = "Oct",
    "month_only^11"       = "Nov",
    "outpatientcount"  = "Montly Outpatient Count"
  ),
  fitstat = ~ n + ar2, 
  style.tex = style.tex("aer")
)


mean_control <- mean(robust_trimmed$Y[robust_trimmed$A == 0], na.rm = TRUE)

extract_estimates <- function(models, label) {
  sapply(models, function(m) {
    est <- coef(m)["A"]
    pct <- (est / mean_control) * 100
    return(c(est = est, pct = pct))
  }) |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::mutate(Method = label)
}

ols_df <- extract_estimates(ols_models, "OLS")
ipw_df <- extract_estimates(ipw_models, "IPW")


## =================================
## Weights diagnostics
## =================================
bal_tab <- bal.tab(
  A ~ province + facilitytype + theft + bedcount + wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean + mean_events + mean_fatalities,
  data = robust_data,
  weights = robust_data$w,
  method = "weighting",
  un = TRUE,      # keep unadjusted
  quick = FALSE   # compute full set
)


love.plot(
  bal_tab,
  thresholds = c(m = .1),
  abs = TRUE,
  var.order = "unadjusted",
  sample.names = c("Unadjusted", "Weighted")
)


ggplot(robust_trimmed, aes(x = ps, fill = factor(A))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "gray", "1" = "blue"),
                    name = "Treatment") +
  labs(x = "Propensity score", y = "Density",
       title = "Propensity Score Overlap: Treated vs. Control") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## TMLE RUNS (Additional Outcomes, Part 1) - Main Results Table 3
```{r otheroutcomes, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# ---------------------------
# Outcome definitions
# ---------------------------
outcomes <- c(
  "mortrate_surgical",
  "mortrate_obgyn",
  "mortrate_peds",
  "mortrate_internalmed",
  "nurse_A1",
  "nurse_A2",
  "doctor",
  "labtech"
)

# ---------------------------
# Initialize storage
# ---------------------------
tmle_results_list_outcomes <- list()
tmle_fits_outcomes <- list()

# ---------------------------
# Loop through outcomes
# ---------------------------
for (yvar in outcomes) {
  message("Running model for outcome: ", yvar)

  # Prep
  snis_filtered <- snis_merged %>%
    filter(!facilitytype %in% c("PH", "H")) %>%
    filter(tmle_list==1) %>%
    mutate(
      month_date_full = my(month),
      month_only = month(month_date_full, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
      suff_reliable = as.integer(sufficient == 1 & uptime > 0.917)  # fixed treatment
    ) %>%
    group_by(id, month_date) %>%
    filter(n() == 1) %>%
    ungroup()

  ltmle_data <- snis_filtered %>%
    arrange(id, month_date) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(time = dense_rank(month_date)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(id, suff_reliable, time, all_of(yvar),
           sufficient, uptime, uptime2, uptime3,
           facilitytype, month_only, province, theft, bedcount, outpatientcount,
           wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean)

  # Drop facilities with all-zero outcome
  zero_ids <- ltmle_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(all_zero = all(.data[[yvar]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(all_zero) %>%
    pull(id)

  ltmle_data <- ltmle_data %>% filter(!id %in% zero_ids)

  # Wide reshape
  Y_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, suff_reliable, all_of(yvar)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = all_of(yvar), names_prefix = "Y_")

  month_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, month_only) %>%
    mutate(month_only = factor(month_only, levels = month.name)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = month_only, names_prefix = "L_month_")

  outpatient_wide <- ltmle_data %>%
    select(id, time, outpatientcount) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = outpatientcount, names_prefix = "L_outpatient_")

  controls <- ltmle_data %>%
    filter(time == 1) %>%
    select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean)

  ltmle_wide <- Y_wide %>%
    left_join(month_wide, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(outpatient_wide, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(controls, by = "id")

  # Nodes
  Ynodes <- grep("^Y_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
  L_month_nodes <- grep("^L_month_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)
  L_outpatient_nodes <- grep("^L_outpatient_", names(ltmle_wide), value = TRUE)

  # Final prep
  ltmle_ready <- ltmle_wide %>%
    mutate(
      suff_reliable = as.numeric(suff_reliable),
      across(all_of(Ynodes), as.numeric),
      across(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ factor(., levels = month.name)),
      facilitytype = as.factor(facilitytype),
      province = as.factor(province),
      theft = as.factor(theft),
      wealth_mean = as.numeric(wealth_mean),
      pop_density_mean = as.numeric(pop_density_mean),
      dist_paved_km_mean = as.numeric(dist_paved_km_mean)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(suff_reliable)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bedcount)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(facilitytype), !is.na(province)) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(Ynodes), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    filter(if_any(all_of(L_month_nodes), ~ !is.na(.)))
  
  ltmle_ready_filtered <- ltmle_ready %>%
    select(id, facilitytype, province, theft, bedcount, wealth_mean, pop_density_mean, dist_paved_km_mean, suff_reliable, all_of(L_month_nodes), all_of(L_outpatient_nodes), all_of(Ynodes))

  # Run TMLE
  gform <- c(suff_reliable = "suff_reliable ~ id + province + facilitytype + theft + bedcount + wealth_mean + pop_density_mean + dist_paved_km_mean")
  
  set.seed(8675309)
  
  tmle_result_outcome <- ltmle(
    data = ltmle_ready_filtered,
    Anodes = "suff_reliable",
    Lnodes = c(L_month_nodes, L_outpatient_nodes),
    Ynodes = Ynodes,
    abar = list(treated = 1, untreated = 0),
    SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.mean", "SL.gam", "SL.rpart",
                   "SL.xgboost.custom", "SL.randomForest.custom"),
    gform = gform
  )

  tmle_sum_outcome <- summary(tmle_result_outcome)

  # Save
  tmle_fits_outcomes[[yvar]] <- tmle_result_outcome
  tmle_results_list_outcomes[[yvar]] <- data.frame(
    outcome = yvar,
    ate = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$ATE$estimate,
    se = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$ATE$std.dev,
    ci_low = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$ATE$CI[1],
    ci_high = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$ATE$CI[2],
    pval = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$ATE$pvalue,
    control_mean = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$control$estimate,
    treated_mean = tmle_sum_outcome$effect.measures$treatment$estimate,
    treated = sum(ltmle_ready$suff_reliable == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    control = sum(ltmle_ready$suff_reliable == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Combine results for outcome models
tmle_results_outcomes_df <- bind_rows(tmle_results_list_outcomes, .id = "model_name")

tmle_results_outcomes_df <- tmle_results_outcomes_df %>%
  mutate(
    family = case_when(
      outcome %in% c("mortrate_surgical", "mortrate_obgyn", 
                     "mortrate_peds", "mortrate_internalmed") ~ "Mortality",
      outcome %in% c("nurse_A1", "nurse_A2", "doctor", "labtech") ~ "Staffing",
      outcome %in% c("outpatientcount", "admissions") ~ "Patient Volume",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  mutate(
    pval_BH_group = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig_BH_group = ifelse(pval_BH_group < 0.05, "*", ""))



```

```{r sensordata, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
  inner_join(sensordata_monthly, by = c("organisationunitname", "month_date"))

  mutate(uptime_sensor = (24 - daily_outage_hrs) / 24 * 100)

total_obs <- sum(!is.na(merged_data$uptime_sensor))
percent_below <- (below_threshold / total_obs) * 100

cat("Number of observations with uptime < 91.7%:", below_threshold, "\n")
cat("Total non-missing observations:", total_obs, "\n")
cat("Percentage below 91.7%:", round(percent_below, 2), "%\n")
```

## TWFE (Within facility analysis) - Main Results Table 4
```{r withinfacility, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}

#-------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create binary reliability variable (> 91.7%)
#-------------------------------------------------------------
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    reliable_binary = ifelse(uptime_sensor > 91.7, 1, 0)
  )

merged_data %>%
  group_by(reliable_binary) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_mortality = mean(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mortality   = sd(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs          = n()
  )


#-------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run models but using binary variable
#-------------------------------------------------------------

# Naïve model (no controls)
fe_tw_reliable_naive <- felm(
  mortrate_active ~ reliable_binary | id + month_date,
  data = merged_data
)

# Full model (with controls)
fe_tw_reliable <- felm(
  mortrate_active ~ reliable_binary + outpatientcount + inpatientcount_active +
    nurse_A1 + labtech | id + month_date,
  data = merged_data
)

#-------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Lagged versions of binary reliability
#-------------------------------------------------------------
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(month_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    reliable_lag1 = dplyr::lag(reliable_binary, 1),
    reliable_lag2 = dplyr::lag(reliable_binary, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Naïve lagged models
fe_tw_reliable_lag_naive <- felm(
  mortrate_active ~ reliable_lag1 | id + month_date,
  data = merged_data
)

# Full lagged models with controls
fe_tw_reliable_lag <- felm(
  mortrate_active ~ reliable_lag1 + outpatientcount + inpatientcount_active +
    nurse_A1 + labtech | id + month_date,
  data = merged_data
)

#-------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Display model summaries
#-------------------------------------------------------------
coeftest(fe_tw_reliable_naive,
         vcov = vcovCR(fe_tw_reliable_naive,
                       cluster = merged_data$id,
                       type = "CR2"))

coeftest(fe_tw_reliable,
         vcov = vcovCR(fe_tw_reliable,
                       cluster = merged_data$id,
                       type = "CR2"))

coeftest(fe_tw_reliable_lag_naive,
         vcov = vcovCR(fe_tw_reliable_lag_naive,
                       cluster = merged_data$id,
                       type = "CR2"))

coeftest(fe_tw_reliable_lag,
         vcov = vcovCR(fe_tw_reliable_lag,
                       cluster = merged_data$id,
                       type = "CR2"))

twfe_inpatient <- felm(
  inpatientcount_active ~ reliable_binary | id + month_date,

)

)
```

## TWFE (Plots) - Figure 4
```{r twfe_shiftcutoff, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# --- 1. Run models for cutoffs 85–95 ---
cutoff_results <- data.frame()

for (c in 85:95) {
  
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    mutate(reliable_binary = ifelse(uptime_sensor > c, 1, 0))
  
  model <- felm(
    mortrate_active ~ reliable_binary + outpatientcount + inpatientcount_active +
      nurse_A1 + labtech | id + month_date,
    data = merged_data
  )
  
  rel_row <- broom::tidy(model) %>% filter(term == "reliable_binary")
  
  cutoff_results <- rbind(
    cutoff_results,
    data.frame(
      cutoff = c / 100,
      estimate = rel_row$estimate,
      std_error = rel_row$std.error,
      ci_low = rel_row$estimate - 1.96 * rel_row$std.error,
      ci_high = rel_row$estimate + 1.96 * rel_row$std.error,
      p_value = rel_row$p.value,
      n_obs = nobs(model)
    )
  )
}

# --- 2. Plot (matching TMLE aesthetic) ---
p_twfe_cutoffs <- ggplot(cutoff_results, aes(x = cutoff, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), alpha = 0.2, fill = "#542788") +
  geom_line(color = "#542788", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#542788", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.85, 0.99, 0.01), labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Shifting Reliability Cutoff (TWFE Sensor Models)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Coefficient on Reliable (> cutoff)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# --- 3. Display ---
print(p_twfe_cutoffs)


```

## SENSOR vs. SURVEY (comparison of uptime measures) - Supplementary Materials Table S1
```{r uptimedefs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    uptime  = as.numeric(uptime),
    uptime2 = as.numeric(uptime2),
    uptime3 = as.numeric(uptime3),
    uptime_sensor = as.numeric(uptime_sensor)
  )

# Collapse sensor measure to facility-level average
facility_avgs <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_sensor_uptime = mean(uptime_sensor, na.rm = TRUE),
    survey_uptime1 = first(uptime),   
    survey_uptime2 = first(uptime2),
    survey_uptime3 = first(uptime3)
  )

# Correlations across facilities
cor_results <- facility_avgs %>%
  summarise(
    cor_uptime1 = cor(survey_uptime1, avg_sensor_uptime, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_uptime2 = cor(survey_uptime2, avg_sensor_uptime, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_uptime3 = cor(survey_uptime3, avg_sensor_uptime, use = "complete.obs")
  )

print(cor_results)

# R² values from regressions
lm_uptime1 <- summary(lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime1, data = facility_avgs))
lm_uptime2 <- summary(lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime2, data = facility_avgs))
lm_uptime3 <- summary(lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime3, data = facility_avgs))

r2_results <- tibble(
  R2_uptime1 = lm_uptime1$r.squared,
  R2_uptime2 = lm_uptime2$r.squared,
  R2_uptime3 = lm_uptime3$r.squared
)

lm_uptime1 <- lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime1, data = facility_avgs)
summary(lm_uptime1)

lm_uptime2 <- lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime2, data = facility_avgs)
summary(lm_uptime2)

lm_uptime3 <- lm(avg_sensor_uptime ~ survey_uptime3, data = facility_avgs)
summary(lm_uptime3)


print(r2_results)

# Define 91.7% threshold
cutoff <- 0.917
cutoff2 <- 91.7

p1 <- ggplot(facility_avgs, aes(x = survey_uptime1, y = avg_sensor_uptime)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#542788") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Survey uptime1", y = "Average sensor uptime")

p2 <- ggplot(facility_avgs, aes(x = survey_uptime2, y = avg_sensor_uptime)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#542788") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Survey uptime2", y = "Average sensor uptime")

p3 <- ggplot(facility_avgs, aes(x = survey_uptime3, y = avg_sensor_uptime)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#542788") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Survey uptime3", y = "Average sensor uptime")

# Combine plots
p1 + p2 + p3
```
